description: Header defining the fifo_async_task_scheduler class for managing asynchronous task scheduling, including methods for scheduling, stopping, and synchronizing tasks, as well as related utility functions.
external_methods: coroutine macros: CORO_BEGIN, CORO_RETURN, CORO_AWAIT, CORO_AWAIT_VALUE, CORO_EARLY_RETURN

classes.name: fifo_async_task_scheduler
classes.description: Manages a queue of asynchronous tasks, executing them sequentially in a dedicated run loop, with methods for scheduling, stopping, and querying task status.

methods.name: fifo_async_task_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with a specified queue size and starting the run loop.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Overloaded template methods to schedule asynchronous tasks or functions.

methods.name: clear_pending_tasks
methods.description: Clears all pending tasks in the queue.

methods.name: request_stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler by enqueuing a termination task and returning an eager_async_task.

methods.name: nof_pending_tasks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tasks.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: is_stopped
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler has been stopped.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Private method that runs the main loop, awaiting and executing tasks until stopped.
